importDescription: Export a HAR file from your browser’s Network panel, then open it here.
privacy: Processed only in your browser. Captures stay in memory and are never uploaded or saved.
sensitive: HAR files can contain cookies, tokens, and personal data. Take care when copying or sharing their contents.
limits: HAR or JSON · up to 20 MiB · 20,000 requests
summaryNote: Totals cover the whole capture. Unknown sizes are excluded; the span runs from the first request to the last recorded finish.
waterfallHint: All requests share one time scale. Select a request to inspect its details.
searchPlaceholder: URL, method, status, or MIME type…
noMatchesHint: Try another search or reset the filters.
bodyMissing: The body was not included in this HAR. Export a capture with content to inspect it.
bodyEncoded: Binary or encoded body. Showing the stored text without rendering it.
bodyTruncated: Preview limited to 100,000 characters. Copy includes only the displayed text.
sslNote: TLS is included in connection time, so it is not added again. Unavailable timings are shown as “Not recorded”.

errors.invalidJson: Could not read JSON. Choose a valid HAR or JSON file exported from your browser.
errors.invalidHar: This file is not a HAR capture. Expected an object with a log.entries array.
errors.noValid: No readable requests were found. Check that entries contain valid timestamps, URLs, methods, and responses.
errors.tooLarge: This file exceeds 20 MiB. Export a smaller capture and try again.
errors.tooMany: This capture exceeds 20,000 requests. Export a shorter capture and try again.
errors.readFailed: Could not read the capture. Choose the file again or try another browser.
